source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: During your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after the unit this model is in has fired, choose an enemy unit struck by at least one of its cult sniper rifle attacks. Until the phase ends, friendly GENESTEALER CULTS models re-roll [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1 when attacking that enemy unit.
